Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

There was a Roma woman with their children, and there was a Roma man with their children, on the train ride home. Both of the sets of kids seemed really tired. The Roma woman's children had been sitting in strollers all day while their parent sat with a sign outside a train station, while the Roma man's children were cranky from eating only sweets their grandparents had given them. Which person was coming home from visiting relatives?
A. Not enough information
B. The Roma man
C. The Roma woman
